what: set-diag-token (the operator-originated-value path, and the ONLY route to restore direct /api/diag/* from a web environment after init-diag-token rotates the value, since nobody can read the rotated value back) writes only /etc/ict-trader/web-api.env. ict-web-api.service loads .env AFTER it, so whenever .env carries DIAG_READ_TOKEN the install is shadowed: the VM keeps serving the .env value while the run reports on its own curl, which then 401s -> 'failed'. The pre-2026-09-27 init_diag_token.sh wrote .env, so a VM it ever ran on carries that line; whether the live VM does is NOT verified (no issue ever invoked init-diag-token, per the manager's search). Plausibly the unexplained half of BL-20260713-SET-DIAG-TOKEN-RESTORE-BROKEN. Fix: make set-diag-token call scripts/ops/init_diag_token.sh rotate with the secret on stdin (same file set, same backups, same no-op refusal).
